title: Access lock decision input (v0.5, D56 and D58, MVP-14 step 1)
description: Input of the access-gate vectors: the protection of one website (without the password hash) and one request as the gate sees it. The result is {answer, reason, status, login_form, canonical_path} (contract/access.Decide). D58: every condition set must hold, the client address (addresses or own networks, either is enough) and a valid session (password); a protection has no end. The protection must also pass the shape check (contract/access.CheckShape): scope site has no paths, scope paths has paths and no except paths, /* is no path of scope paths, except paths are plain (no empty, '.' or '..' segment, no segment ending in a dot), every address is an IP or a network with zero host bits (IPv4 /16 or longer, IPv6 /32 or longer, no IPv4 in IPv6), and there is a way in (password, an address or own networks); else the vector is invalid with code schema. Never sent anywhere.

path.description: The request path as received, in its escaped form, without the query.

client_ip.description: The client address as the gate resolved it; absent = unknown.
